{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the first few rows to confirm structure
print(df.head())

# Confirm the dtype of revenue
print(f"Revenue dtype: {df['revenue'].dtype}")

# Check for the QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Display the unique values in channel
print(f"Unique channels: {df['channel'].unique()}")"}
